verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order and the divider between the two phrases. The text is large and readable and the layout reads left to right, but the rose is clipped hard into a rectangle with visible straight edges, 'When Life Is Great' nearly touches the rose, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B is broken: the order is jumbled (PRAY / Great / Rough / PRAY), so the message no longer makes sense; 'When Life Is Rough' is tiny and off-axis, the divider is stranded at the bottom-left corner beside the rose, and the text is small with lots of empty space.
